sara_sales: FYI inbound from Acme Retail — they sent a SIG/CAIQ and are asking for evidence for a short POC. Can someone claim and confirm what we can share?

michael_security: I can take it. Quick Q: is this POC using customer data or synthetic only? Need to know for evidence scope.

sara_sales: POC will ingest customer CSVs (anonymized), but they expect logs + config screenshots. Budget is tight — they asked if any extra fees for BYOK or private VPC.

michael_security: If they require BYOK + private VPC that's typically an enterprise add-on (sales handles pricing). For the questionnaire itself I'll start SIG answers. Tagging @lee_solutions to double-check POC constraints.

lee_solutions: @michael_security please call out SSO/SCIM + audit log retention in answers. For screenshots we can redact identifiers. Also confirm whether we need signed DPA before sharing any exports.

amy_engineer: I can grab sanitized config screenshots and run `pg_dump --schema-only` for schema proof. I won't include any personal data. Will need a ticket for evidence upload.

security_bot: New security intake created: TKT-4821. Assigned to michael_security. Intake form: https://redwood.ai/intake/TKT-4821 (contains upload/expiration rules).

ops_bot: FYI deploy window for private VPC onboarding is ~2-3 weeks; BYOK take ~5 business days to validate KMS integration.

sara_sales: Client timeline is tight — wants POC in 10 business days. Can we deliver minimal answers + redacted evidence faster?

michael_security: We'll do a prioritized pass: 1) complete SIG/CAIQ high-risk controls 2) provide redacted screenshots + schema dump 3) note BYOK as optional add-on with ops timeline. I'll flag anything that requires legal/DPA.

lee_solutions: Suggest we add a note in the intake about data residency; Acme asked for EU-only processing. That may change hosting options.

amy_engineer: Working on screenshots now, ETA EOD today. Will drop artifacts to TKT-4821 uploads.

sara_sales: Awesome. @michael_security please post a short summary I can forward to the customer (bullet list + ask for any legal docs).

michael_security: Will do — I'll post a short customer-facing summary in this thread once uploads are live. :thumbsup:

security_bot: Reminder: evidence uploads expire 30 days by default; request extended retention in the intake if needed.
